name: bare-linux
description: Example of embedding Bare in a Linux application

scripts.fetch: curl -fsSL https://github.com/holepunchto/bare-kit/releases/download/v2.3.0/prebuilds.zip -o prebuilds.zip && unzip -o prebuilds.zip 'linux/*' -d prebuilds/ && mkdir -p app/lib && cp prebuilds/linux/$(uname -m | sed 's/aarch64/arm64/;s/x86_64/x64/')/libbare-kit.so app/lib/
scripts.bundle: npm run link && npm run pack

author: Holepunch
